be stranded at the airport: Because of the heavy snow, hundreds of travelers will be stranded at the airport until tomorrow morning.
因為大雪，數百名旅客將被困在機場直到明天早上。
a strand of hair: The detective found a strand of hair on the sofa and sent it to the lab for testing.
警探在沙發上發現一縷頭髮，並把它送到實驗室化驗。
leave someone stranded: The last bus left without us, which left us stranded in the small town with no hotel.
最後一班公車沒等我們就開走了，讓我們進退兩難地困在沒有旅館的小鎮。
strands of a story: In the final chapter, the writer skillfully brings all the strands of a story together.
在最後一章，作者巧妙地把故事所有的線索串在一起。
strap in: Before the roller coaster starts, every rider must strap in and keep their hands inside the car.
雲霄飛車開動前，每位乘客都必須繫好安全帶，雙手保持在車內。
be strapped for cash: I'd love to join you for the concert, but I'm strapped for cash until I get paid next week.
我很想跟你們去聽演唱會，但我手頭很緊，要等下週領薪水。
strap on a backpack: The hikers strap on a backpack full of water and snacks before climbing the mountain every weekend.
健行者每個週末爬山前都會背上一個裝滿水和點心的背包。
strap down: Make sure you strap down the boxes on the truck so they won't fall off on the highway.
務必把卡車上的箱子綁緊，免得它們在高速公路上掉下來。
stream a movie: Instead of going to the theater, we decided to stream a movie at home and order some pizza.
我們沒去電影院，而是決定在家串流電影，並叫了些披薩。
tears streamed down: When she heard that her dog had been found, tears streamed down her face with joy.
當她聽到她的狗被找到時，喜悅的淚水流滿她的臉。
people streamed out: As soon as the concert ended, people streamed out of the stadium and filled the nearby streets.
演唱會一結束，人群就從體育場湧出，擠滿了附近的街道。
stream students by ability: Some schools stream students by ability, putting the fastest learners together in one special class.
有些學校按能力分班，把學得最快的學生放在同一個特別班。
live stream: Thousands of fans watched the live stream of the game on their phones because they couldn't buy tickets.
數千名球迷用手機觀看比賽的直播，因為他們買不到票。
strengthen ties: The two schools started an exchange program to strengthen ties between students in Taiwan and Japan.
兩所學校開辦了交換計畫，以強化台灣和日本學生之間的關係。
strengthen one's position: By winning three games in a row, the team strengthened its position at the top of the league.
連贏三場比賽後，該隊鞏固了自己在聯盟中的領先地位。
strengthen the economy: The government hopes that lowering taxes will create more jobs and strengthen the economy next year.
政府希望減稅能創造更多工作機會，並在明年強化經濟。
strengthen the case: The new photos from the camera will strengthen the case against the driver who caused the accident.
監視器拍到的新照片會使控告肇事駕駛的論點更有力。
strengthen muscles: Swimming three times a week can strengthen muscles in your arms, legs, and back.
每週游泳三次可以強化你手臂、腿和背部的肌肉。
the dollar strengthened: After the good news about jobs, the dollar strengthened, so our trip to America became more expensive.
就業好消息發布後，美元走強，所以我們的美國之旅變得更貴了。
stress the importance: Our teacher always stresses the importance of reading every day if we want to improve our English.
我們老師總是強調，如果想提升英文，每天閱讀很重要。
be stressed out: Many students are stressed out before the exam, so they find it hard to eat or sleep.
許多學生在考試前壓力爆表，所以很難吃得下或睡得著。
stress the need for: The doctor stressed the need for more exercise and less sugar to keep my blood pressure down.
醫生強調需要多運動、少吃糖，才能讓我的血壓降下來。
under stress: Some people make poor choices when they are under stress, so take a deep breath before deciding.
有些人在壓力下會做出糟糕的選擇，所以做決定前先深呼吸。
lay stress on: In her speech, the principal decided to lay stress on safety rules for the school trip.
校長在演講中決定強調校外教學的安全規定。
stretch the truth: When he talked about the size of the fish he caught, he liked to stretch the truth a little.
當他談到自己釣到的魚有多大時，總愛稍微誇大事實。
stretch the budget: To stretch the budget until the end of the month, we cooked at home instead of eating out.
為了讓預算撐到月底，我們在家煮飯而不外食。
stretch one's legs: After sitting on the bus for four hours, we got off to stretch our legs and buy some drinks.
在公車上坐了四個小時後，我們下車伸展一下腿，順便買些飲料。
stretch the rules: The teacher agreed to stretch the rules and let me hand in my report one day late.
老師同意通融規定，讓我晚一天交報告。
stretch oneself: Joining the speech contest was hard, but I wanted to stretch myself and try something new.
參加演講比賽很難，但我想挑戰自我，嘗試新事物。
at a stretch: My little brother can play video games for five hours at a stretch if nobody stops him.
如果沒人阻止，我弟弟可以一口氣打五個小時的電動。
stretch over years: The building of the new train line will stretch over years, so the roads will be busy for a long time.
新鐵路線的興建將延續數年，所以道路會擁擠很長一段時間。
stretch to the limit: With so many sick patients arriving, the small hospital was stretched to the limit last winter.
去年冬天大量病患湧入，這家小醫院被逼到了極限。
